lines.text: Not a fresh catalyst: the latest company event in our sources is the August 17, 2026 closing of a $10.0 million private placement of 3,412,970 units at $2.93 per unit, each with one ordinary share and a warrant exercisable at $4.40, and the October 2 premarket mover item at 08:05 ET gives no company-specific reason for today's move. The desk notes the issued shares and the company's broader financing capacity as the relevant points, and our sources do not show whether any company announcement came after the August financing.

Nasdaq notified Cycurion at 09:13 ET on October 2, 2026 that it regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price after ten consecutive closes above $1.00 following the August 28, 2026 1-for-8 reverse split, with a Discretionary Panel Monitor in place through October 9, 2027. The desk reads this as the removal of an immediate listing issue, qualified by the monitor and the reverse-split context, and our sources do not separate the notice from concurrent attention to the company interview and earlier operating milestones.

Alpha Modus reported on October 1, 2026 (8-K at 07:30 ET) the completion of a shares-for-Bitcoin PIPE in which its subsidiary received 3,170 Bitcoin, reported as valued above $250 million, with secondary coverage putting the issuance at 51.6 million common shares and matching warrants at $4.36. The desk reads the Bitcoin holding as a material change to the stated balance-sheet story paired with a sizable new equity issuance, and the primary filing excerpt in our sources does not state the PIPE share figure, warrant terms, resale restrictions or registration status, so those terms rest on secondary coverage.

The company furnished its semi-annual report after the October 1 session, showing a $17.21 million loss attributable to shareholders for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and describing convertible-note financing that may dilute holders on conversion. The desk reads the conversion dilution as an adverse consideration rather than evidence that conversion shares have been sold, and our sources do not tie the filing to today's move or show how much of the notes has converted.
No research is on file for TRAD at this checkpoint.

QTREX reported at 13:20 ET on October 1, 2026 that a leading quantum-computing company independently tested its interconnect at 20 mK and found channel isolation above 100 dB across the 4 to 8 GHz qubit band, stated as 60 dB beyond the market leader, and said it was finalizing a binding definitive agreement with that company, with identity and terms to be disclosed within weeks. The desk reads this as a possible customer validation step for the interconnect platform, with the counterparty, terms, contract value and execution status undisclosed and no revenue, purchase commitments or deliveries in our sources.

No catalyst found in our sources: the late September and October 1 company communications (Boston Herald media-coverage items, a gold trust-layer piece and a Made in America piece) disclose no contract, approval, financing or operating result, and a 02:36 ET October 2 secondary report attributes after-hours activity to company updates without naming one. The desk reads the stream of releases as attention-drawing without a material company-specific event, and full text and terms for the October 1 releases are not in our sources.
No research is on file for INAC at this checkpoint; since the previous checkpoint it lost $10.38 support.
No research is on file for GLED at this checkpoint.

Not a fresh catalyst: at 20:33 ET on July 21, 2026 FACT II announced termination of its proposed business combination with Precision Aerospace & Defense Group, and the parties later requested withdrawal of the related S-4 at 20:01 ET on August 13, 2026. The desk reads this as a return to the SPAC search and trust/redemption framework, and our sources hold no non-SEC catalyst item and do not show whether a more recent company event exists.

A secondary headline at 08:08 ET on October 2, 2026 reported that Autonomix received Canadian Patent No. 3,183,802 for catheter-based nerve-treatment technology; the underlying company announcement and patent document are not in our sources. The desk reads it as widening reported intellectual-property coverage that could draw speculative interest, with no near-term revenue or regulatory clearance established, no market or licensing value quantified, and no link to the trading activity shown.
No research is on file for WENC at this checkpoint; since the previous checkpoint it printed a new high of day.
